description: a half ball r 5, as tests/fixtures/real/edge-through-sphere-pole writes it, shown in two AP242 saved views: a DRAUGHTING_MODEL whose MAPPED_ITEM maps the part's shape from a CAMERA_MODEL_D3, as NIST's CTC-01 AP242 edition writes #34, and a complex DRAUGHTING_MODEL SHAPE_REPRESENTATION whose MAPPED_ITEM maps it 20 mm along x, as its other editions write #31. A presentation places nothing: the reader flattens the product structure without them and reads one solid, where it once refused the camera as a placement and read the displaced view as a second body (ADR-0026, amendment of step 9)
source: written by hand for this fixture, shrunk from NIST parts (ADR-0026 §4)
